inspection: Public documentation and preserved historical entities only; no authenticated API inspection

documented.request: model selects a name/alias; state is string/object/array; questions maps caller-chosen names to typed questions
documented.selected_catalog: The approved Choice 1 catalog uses three Nouls for this single-claim input; no auxiliary Choice extension
documented.response: answers keyed by question name; model self-report; usage input_tokens/output_tokens
documented.fixed_revision: Models page explicitly documents versioned IDs as accepted, even when omitted from the account models listing
documented.alias: jev-latest moves with stable releases; models page currently maps it to jev-1.14.0
documented.historical_evidence: The five preserved entities report jev-1.13.0; none establishes current account entitlement or independent attestation
documented.SDK_retries: Documented client-side automatic retries exist; this transport imports no provider SDK and performs no retry

unknowns_and_exact_provider_questions.account_entitlement: Can the selected account currently request jev-1.13.0, and for how long is that revision retained? Supply account-specific evidence without an inference call.
unknowns_and_exact_provider_questions.immutable_identity: Does a versioned ID guarantee immutable serving weights/configuration? What signed or otherwise independently verifiable evidence identifies the serving revision?
unknowns_and_exact_provider_questions.correlation: Which response header/entity field is the durable request identifier, and can it be reconciled with the exact request digest and an account usage/billing export? Generic request-ID headers are captured if present but are not a documented guarantee.
unknowns_and_exact_provider_questions.remote_replay: Can one accepted POST be internally retried, replayed or executed more than once? Does any idempotency mechanism bound execution or billing? No provider idempotency header is sent or assumed.
unknowns_and_exact_provider_questions.timeout_completion: After a client timeout/disconnect, can execution continue, and how can its final execution and charge be reconciled without resubmission?
unknowns_and_exact_provider_questions.usage_and_cost_cap: Is there an enforceable account or per-request input-token/spend cap for this request? What are the applicable account tariff, rounding, minimum charge and error/timeout billing rules?
unknowns_and_exact_provider_questions.credential_provision: Can a least-privilege credential be provisioned to the approved broker secret interface with account attribution, scope and expiry? No real credential has been read or configured.

local_only_blockers.production_egress: BLOCKED: only private loopback namespace/nftables/seccomp is qualified. A production numeric destination/IP update and firewall deployment policy, system trust store and secret implementation require separate qualification.
local_only_blockers.live_enablement: No implementation. DISABLED is enforced; changing the switch and resealing does not launch.
local_only_blockers.usage_cap: No verified account cap; maximum_usage and maximum_cost remain null rather than invented. Response byte limits do not bound remote compute or charges.
